title: Enquiries: manage authorized admin emails from the dashboard

requirements.summary: Add an Enquiries dashboard “Admin Access” panel to list, add, and remove authorized admin emails (authorized users only).
acceptanceCriteria: When the current user is authorized for enquiries, the Enquiries dashboard displays an “Admin Access” (or similar) panel showing the current authorized admin email list.
The panel provides an input + button to add a new admin email and shows success/error toasts based on the result.
Each listed email has a remove action (with a simple confirmation) that removes it and refreshes the list.
The UI disables actions while requests are in-flight and handles backend errors gracefully.

file_operations.description: Create React Query hooks for enquiry-admin email management using backend capabilities: fetch authorized admin email list, add email, remove email; include loading states, error propagation, and query invalidation after mutations. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

When enquiries access is authorized, add an “Admin Access” panel near the top of the dashboard that: (1) shows the fetched authorized email list, (2) includes an input + add button, (3) renders per-email remove actions with a confirmation, (4) disables controls while requests are in-flight, and (5) uses toast notifications for success/error. Use shadcn-ui components (Card, Button, Input, Badge/Label as appropriate) for consistent UI. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Remove frontend hardcoded admin email list usage for Access Denied diagnostics; base “Email Authorized” on backend-managed list.
acceptanceCriteria: The app no longer needs to keep the backend and frontend admin email lists manually in sync for authorization diagnostics.
In the Access Denied screen, the “Email Authorized: Yes/No” determination is based on the backend-managed list (fetched from the backend), not a local constant.

file_operations.description: Deprecate/remove reliance on the hardcoded AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_EMAILS list for authorization diagnostics (keep only non-authoritative utilities if still needed). Ensure no UI diagnostics depend on this list anymore.

Update the Access Denied diagnostic block to compute “Email Authorized: Yes/No” by comparing the caller profile email against the backend-fetched authorized email list (case-insensitive). Show a sensible loading state while the list is being fetched and handle backend errors gracefully without crashing. Use shadcn-ui components already present in the view. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add concise guidance on the Enquiries access flow explaining how a new admin gains access (II login + matching authorized profile email).
acceptanceCriteria: The Enquiries view includes a short explanation (English) stating that access is granted by authorizing an email and that the admin must log in with Internet Identity and save a matching profile email.
Copy is concise and appears near the login/profile completion flow where users are most likely to need it.

file_operations.description: Add concise, user-facing guidance text near: (1) the “Login Required” card and (2) the profile completion/edit profile forms, explaining that an owner/authorized admin must add the email to the authorized list, then the new admin must log in with Internet Identity and save the same email in their profile to gain access. Use existing typography styles/components for consistency (shadcn-ui Card content text). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
